messages:
elaine: Quick pulse — pulled channel-level MQLs + demo requests for the last 7 days. Paid social shows a big volume lift but conversion to demos is lower than email/org. Dropping raw numbers below, can someone sanity-check before I bake into the weekly deck? :eyes:

sam: On it, drop the numbers here and any filters you used.

elaine: Numbers (7d window):
- Total MQLs: 1,248
- Paid social: 420 MQLs, conv -> demo 3.1%
- Organic blog / SEO: 310 MQLs, conv -> demo 6.5%
- Webinar cohort: 180 registrants / 45 demos (25% -> demo conversion 0.9% overall)
- Email nurture: 338 MQLs, conv -> demo 5.2%
Notes: paid social CPC +18% MoM, creative rotated 03/12. Filters: utm_source and routed leads only (post-processor v2).

mike: Hmm the webinar -> demo conversion looks off vs prior cohorts. Could we be double-attributing demo credits to direct or missing events in the pipeline? I saw some webhook retries on 03/14.

analytics-bot: ingest-monitor: detected 14% event loss on webhook-prod between 2026-03-14T02:00:00Z and 2026-03-14T03:00:00Z. Affected: lead.created events.

tara: If ingest is missing events, that would depress webinar demo counts. @mike can you validate routing sample rates and confirm whether our attribution window settings might surface demos to a different channel?

mike: Will check. Quick repro SQL I ran as a sanity check: `SELECT source, count(*) as leads FROM leads WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-14' AND created_at < '2026-03-21' GROUP BY source;` Looks like webhook-sourced leads are ~50% of expected for 03/14. Opening ops ticket now.

elainedidntexist: ??? Wait, typo — sorry ignore that line.

mike: Ticket created: OPS-4578 (ingest drop on 03/14). Assigned to eng-infra. ETA initial triage 3 hours.

sam: Good. For the weekly KPI deck, do we want channel-level ROI table or keep to high-level trends? My vote: include ROI + conversion rates but hide channels with <30 leads to reduce noise.

tara: Agree. Also include cohort LTV estimate for paid social (qtd) — helps frame ROI callouts.

mike: I'll add cohort counts once OPS-4578 resolved and we recalc. ETA ~24h after triage.

elain e: Cool — I'll hold the final slides until numbers are reconciled. Can we huddle 10:00am PT tomorrow to finalize?

sam: @tara @mike that works for me.

tara: Works.

deploy-bot: weekly-kpi-deck.pdf uploaded to #marketing-drive: https://drive.redwood/example/weekly-kpi-deck_v0.9.pdf (auto-upload from /shared/marketing).

elaine: Perfect — will review post-sync and finalize narrative. Thanks team :raised_hands:
